title: abrahamaiproject-bit/atlas-routing-engine
body:
# atlas-routing-engine

Core route-optimization engine for **Project Atlas**, Lumen Freight's next-generation routing platform.

It solves capacitated vehicle routing problems with time windows (CVRPTW) for fleets of up to 500 vehicles.

## Maintainers
- Joe Smith (VP of Engineering), tech lead

## Getting started
```bash
make install
make test
make run
```

## Roadmap
- [x] Time-window constraints
- [ ] Live traffic re-optimization
- [ ] Multi-depot support for the Harbor Logistics pilot
